body.en:
Question B-001-015-002.

Why the correct answer is right: When you control another station, you may use only the privileges allowed by your own qualifications.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Any privileges allowed by the additional qualifications": The station owner's extra qualifications do not automatically become yours at the control point.
- sourceIndex 2: "All the emission privileges of the additional qualifications, but only the frequency privileges of your qualifications": The bank does not divide privilege borrowing into emission-only permission.
- sourceIndex 3: "All the frequency privileges of the additional qualifications, but only the emission privileges of your qualifications": Frequency privileges are not borrowed separately from the other station owner's certificate.
